changes: Renamed the lab experiment schema id koala-lab/experiment.v1 -> lattice-lab/experiment.v1 across packages/lab/src/core/config.ts (the $schema output marker), packages/main/tests/fixtures/lab-foundation.json (schema-id assertion + koala-lab-fixture- mkdtemp prefix), and removed the now-dead koala-lab exemption regex in scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs.
usage: New lab experiment configs now emit $schema: lattice-lab/experiment.v1. Existing experiments/ data keeping the old id still loads fine (lab does not validate incoming $schema).
expectedOutcome: git grep koala-lab over active scope (excluding experiments/ history + CHANGELOG) returns nothing; the koala-residue gate PASSes; build + e2e green.
actualTranscript: git grep koala-lab active scope -> 0; node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs -> PASS koala-residue: 0 unclassified; --self-test -> 5/5; npm run build -> exit 0; lattice validate -> ALL PASS (e2e consumes lab-foundation.json + runs test:koala-residue).
limitations: experiments/ historical prose and CHANGELOG.md keep koala-lab as documented exceptions (historical records, not active code). lab does not validate $schema, so no migration of existing experiment data is needed.
pitfalls: New lab experiment configs now use schema id lattice-lab/experiment.v1; any external tooling that string-matched the old koala-lab/experiment.v1 id would need updating (none found in this repo).
